status: premodel scope clarification; no freeze or geometry yet
supported_final_scope: Lygodium kaulfussi isolated bifid foliage organ with attached branched fertile structure, inspired by NPS fossil FOBU12018. Not a complete climbing frond or whole organism.
basis: NPS specimen pixels personally inspected: two long blunt laminar lobes converge at a narrow upper attachment near a small subdivided fertile branch. Manchester and Zavada 1987 describes fossil fertile and sterile foliage; modern Lygodium palmatum climbing habit is comparison, not direct whole-organism fossil proof.
decision: Coordinator confirmed inventory was planning, not an explicit user whole-organism requirement. Transparent organ-level clarification before concepts and freeze, preserving original plan.
